title: Design system documentation

body.text: A design system with no docs = no one follows it — Claude helps write
component docs: when to use it, how to use it, and when not to
— it can write a usage guideline from a screenshot or the component's code.

example: "Write docs for the Primary button: use for the one main action per screen / don't use for destructive actions — use Danger instead"

title: Docs developers read and use correctly

body.text: one-sentence overview → when to use/not use → code example → props/variants → common mistakes
— the last part is the most valuable, because it prevents the repeated misuse that actually happens on the team.

example: "From this Modal component, write docs in the 5-part structure, emphasizing common mistakes like nesting a modal inside a modal"

question: What questions must component docs answer?

options.text: When to use it, how to use it, when not to

question: Which part of the docs best prevents repeated misuse?
What happens to a design system with no documentation?

options.text: The team uses it inconsistently and the system loses its meaning

question: What should good design system documentation be like?

options.text: Clear enough that a developer reads it and uses it correctly

question: How does design system documentation help the team?

options.text: Everyone uses the components and rules consistently
